summary: The exact candidate fixes the original linear_fc dimension/normalization failure and the previously missed unindexed MOSS-VL merger registration and adapter-weight routing. Candidate regressions and independent adversarial source-level cases pass.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: 12 failed and 4 passed, covering linear_fc dimensions, Qwen3-VL deep-stack indexing, MOSS-VL registration, and MOSS-VL adapter-weight placement.
Nine independent adversarial cases for manager registration, adapter routing, path boundaries, decoder precedence, and varied MOSS-VL dimensions.
Python syntax/import compilation for affected runtime areas.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU was visible, but issue-specific full-model execution was not run because the Qwen3-VL-8B and EditScore weights were not prepared. Tests exercised the real source initialization logic on CPU fixtures.

remaining_limitations: No end-to-end Qwen3-VL-8B plus EditScore adapter server startup or generation was run.
The available architecture was AMD MI355X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not the reported NVIDIA H100 NVL with CUDA 13.2.
The unindexed Qwen3-VL primary visual.merger remains unrouted, but the captured issue adapter targets only indexed deep-stack merger modules; this is outside the reproduced original contract.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes no native source.
